description: Asks the person before an Edit or Write makes a spec Approved (spec 025). Never allows, never blocks.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c "" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
